title: Tuckahoe (Southampton)
summary: Tuckahoe is a level tract of land and school district north of Southampton Village.
history_content: The name is connected with a plant whose tubers were gathered for food. The modern marker uses the Tuckahoe hamlet area as a general location.
translation_content:
Tuckahoe is treated as a plant-name placename rather than a translated landform term.

Why Place Names Matter

“The words we choose for places demonstrate our values and the stories we deem worthy of passing on.”

— Aunty Geraldine Atkinson, Call for more First Nations place names on International Mother Language Day (2023), Direct quotation, paragraph 8
preservation_content: Tuckahoe preserves knowledge of plant gathering and foodways in the Southampton landscape, linking a modern hamlet name with older ecological memory.
